pairs: Et audivi vocem magnam de templo,
And I heard a great voice from the temple,
dicentem septem angelis:
saying to the seven Angels:
Ite,
“Go forth
et effundite septem phialas iræ Dei in terram.
and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God upon the earth.”
Et abiit primus, et effudit phialam suam in terram,
And the first Angel went forth and poured out his bowl upon the earth.
et factum est vulnus sævum et pessimum in homines, qui habebant caracterem bestiæ,
And a severe and most grievous wound occurred upon the men who had the character of the beast,
et in eos qui adoraverunt imaginem ejus.
and upon those who adored the beast or its image.
Et secundus angelus effudit phialam suam in mare,
And the second Angel poured out his bowl upon the sea.
et factus est sanguis tamquam mortui:
And it became like the blood of the dead,
et omnis anima vivens mortua est in mari.
and every living creature in the sea died.
Et tertius effudit phialam suam super flumina,
And the third Angel poured out his bowl upon the rivers
et super fontes aquarum,
and the sources of water,
et factus est sanguis.
and these became blood.
Et audivi angelum aquarum dicentem:
And I heard the Angel of the waters saying:
Justus es,
“You are just,
Domine,
O Lord,
qui es,
who is
et qui eras sanctus,
and who was:
qui hæc judicasti:
the Holy One who has judged these things.
quia sanguinem sanctorum et prophetarum effuderunt,
For they have shed the blood of the Saints and the Prophets,
et sanguinem eis dedisti bibere:
and so you have given them blood to drink.
digni enim sunt.
For they deserve this.”
Et audivi alterum ab altari dicentem:
And from the altar, I heard another one, saying,
Etiam Domine Deus omnipotens,
“Even now, O Lord God Almighty,
vera et justa judicia tua.
your judgments are true and just.”
Et quartus angelus effudit phialam suam in solem,
And the fourth Angel poured out his bowl upon the sun.
et datum est illi æstu affligere homines,
And it was given to him to afflict men with heat
et igni:
and fire.
et æstuaverunt homines æstu magno,
And men were scorched by the great heat,
et blasphemaverunt nomen Dei habentis potestatem super has plagas,
and they blasphemed the name of God, who holds power over these afflictions,
neque egerunt pœnitentiam ut darent illi gloriam.
but they did not repent, so as to give him glory.
Et quintus angelus effudit phialam suam super sedem bestiæ:
And the fifth Angel poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast.
et factum est regnum ejus tenebrosum,
And his kingdom became darkened,
et commanducaverunt linguas suas præ dolore:
and they gnawed at their tongues out of anguish.
et blasphemaverunt Deum cæli præ doloribus,
And they blasphemed the God of heaven,
et vulneribus suis,
because of their anguish and wounds,
et non egerunt pœnitentiam ex operibus suis.
but they did not repent from their works.
Et sextus angelus effudit phialam suam in flumen illud magnum Euphraten:
And the sixth Angel poured out his bowl upon that great river Euphrates.
et siccavit aquam ejus,
And its water dried up,
ut præpararetur via regibus ab ortu solis.
so that a way might be prepared for the kings from the rising of the sun.
Et vidi de ore draconis,
And I saw, from the mouth of the dragon,
et de ore bestiæ,
and from the mouth of the beast,
et de ore pseudoprophetæ spiritus tres immundos in modum ranarum.
and from the mouth of the false prophetess, three unclean spirits go out in the manner of frogs.
Sunt enim spiritus dæmoniorum facientes signa,
For these are the spirits of the demons that were causing the signs.
et procedunt ad reges totius terræ congregare illos in prælium ad diem magnum omnipotentis Dei.
And they advanced to the kings of the entire earth, to gather them for battle on the great day of Almighty God.
Ecce venio sicut fur.
“Behold, I arrive like a thief.
Beatus qui vigilat, et custodit vestimenta sua,
Blessed is he who is vigilant and who preserves his vestment,
ne nudus ambulet, et videant turpitudinem ejus.
lest he walk naked and they see his disgrace.”
Et congregabit illos in locum qui vocatur hebraice Armagedon.
And he shall gather them together at a place which is called, in Hebrew, Armageddon.
Et septimus angelus effudit phialam suam in aërem,
And the seventh Angel poured out his bowl upon the air.
et exivit vox magna de templo a throno,
And a great voice went out of the temple from the throne,
dicens:
saying:
Factum est.
“It is done.”
Et facta sunt fulgura, et voces, et tonitrua,
And there were lightnings and voices and thunders.
et terræmotus factus est magnus,
And a great earthquake occurred,
qualis numquam fuit ex quo homines fuerunt super terram:
of a kind such as has never happened since men have been upon the earth,
talis terræmotus, sic magnus.
so great was this kind of earthquake.
Et facta est civitas magna in tres partes:
And the Great City became divided into three parts.
et civitates gentium ceciderunt.
And the cities of the Gentiles fell.
Et Babylon magna venit in memoriam ante Deum,
And Babylon the great came to mind before God,
dare illi calicem vini indignationis iræ ejus.
to give her the cup of the wine of the indignation of his wrath.
Et omnis insula fugit,
And every island fled away,
et montes non sunt inventi.
and the mountains were not found.
Et grando magna sicut talentum descendit de cælo in homines:
And hail as heavy as a talent descended from the sky upon men.
et blasphemaverunt Deum homines propter plagam grandinis:
And men blasphemed God, because of the affliction of the hail,
quoniam magna facta est vehementer.
for it was exceedingly great.
